preconditions.description: The number of crimes Zeyad wants to commit is between 0 and 10^18.
The number of conditions is between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= ti <= 'Z' for ti, mi in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each crime type is a capital Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(mi > 0 for ti, mi in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each multiplicity is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: reduce(lambda x, y: x * y, [mi for ti, mi in conditions], 1) <= 123
preconditions.description: The product of all multiplicities does not exceed 123.

postconditions.description: The number of ways is non-negative.
The number of ways is less than 12345.
The number of ways Zeyad can commit exactly n crimes without any punishment modulo 12345.
